verdict.rationale: First-party OneDrive docs say it enables real-time coauthoring in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, which covers docs, sheets and slides being edited in place. The pack's sync complaints are about file syncing, not coauthoring, so they don't bear on this story. missing for 10: explicit evidence that coauthoring happens in the browser (e.g. Office for the web), in-depth documentation of the co-editing experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
